Jordy is de eerste kandidaat en imponeert iedereen met zijn fantastische dansmoves. Hij wordt hierdoor plots heel populair. Zo populair zelfs dat de Brollers op hem zullen stemmen als nieuwe voorzitter van de leerlingenraad. programme.desc: Kevin and Dieter wake up in Sint-Martens-Leerne and decide to sail straight to Ghent. They are caught in heavy rain and thunder and are forced to take shelter. In Ghent they cannot get under the low bridges with De Goudvis, and they need help to take down their roof. They can go for a barbecue with a young Ghent couple and their group of friends. The next day they sail to Schellebelle with a stopover in Merelbeke. They get to know a lot of new people. / Kevin en Dieter ontwaken in Sint-Martens-Leerne en besluiten rechtstreeks naar Gent te varen. Ze komen terecht in hevige regen en onweer, en moeten noodgedwongen schuilen. In Gent geraken ze niet onder de lage brugjes door met De Goudvis, en hebben ze hulp nodig om hun dak naar beneden te halen. Ze mogen mee gaan barbecueën met een jong Gents koppel en hun vriendengroep. De volgende dag varen ze naar Schellebelle met een tussenstop in Merelbeke. Ze leren weer heel wat nieuwe mensen kennen.

programme.desc: Pascale is turning fifty and that is not going well for her, mainly thanks to the well-intentioned interference of the other Champions. On a rebellious impulse, she decides to dress and act like a twenty-year-old. And the unbelievable happens: she finds a handsome boy, Maarten, who apparently falls in love with her. The other Champions, with Bieke and Boma in the lead, are having a very difficult time with this. But Pascale doesn't want to listen to reason... / Pascale wordt vijftig en dat gaat haar niet goed af, vooral dankzij de goedbedoelde bemoeienissen van de andere Kampioenen. In een rebelse opwelling besluit ze zich als een twintigjarige te kleden en gedragen. En het ongelofelijke gebeurt: ze vindt een knappe jongen, Maarten, die blijkbaar op haar verliefd wordt. programme.title: First Dates / First Dates
programme.desc: Gino goes on a date with Renaldo, both have little relationship experience and are ready to fall in love. They already have a common hobby: gaming. Thomas is from Antwerp, Justine from Ghent. Thomas is a DJ, and that excites Justine. Monica is from Chile and is looking for someone who can help her discover Belgium. She goes on a friendship date with Mohamed. Thomas and Froukje both have autism. They are looking for someone who understands them. Do they find support from each other? / Gino gaat op date met Renaldo, beide hebben ze weinig relatie-ervaring en zijn ze klaar om verliefd te worden. Ze hebben alvast een gemeenschappelijke hobby: gamen. Thomas is van Antwerpen, Justine van Gent. Thomas is dj, en dat prikkelt Justine wel. Monica is afkomstig uit Chili en zoekt iemand die haar België kan laten ontdekken. Ze gaat op vriendschapsdate met Mohamed. Thomas en Froukje hebben allebei autisme. Ze zoeken iemand die hen begrijpt. Vinden ze steun bij elkaar?

programme.title: Exercise with Lydia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world we often don't have time to exercise. Many are the benefits of regular exercise. In addition to body shaping, you are also provided with good health. In addition to good physical form, exercise contributes to good mental health. By exercising, endorphins relax, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positive. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.desc: Specialized and sponsored emissions dedicated to the world of the automotive industry. programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. programme.desc: National teams from different continents compete in groups and playoffs to win a place among the best to fight for the world title. programme.title: Basketball: League Endes: 2 Circle: HOVETUT - Zaragoza / Баскетбол: Лига Ендеса: 2 кръг: Ховентут - Сарагоса
programme.desc: The Spanish Basketball League was founded in 1957 as the National League and received its current format in 1983, when the ACB organization took control of the competition. According to the scoring, the ACB League is one of the top three European leagues. Currently, 18 teams are participating in the league, playing with each other twice during the season. The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, but tightly followed by Barcelona. The Spanish Championship gave us some of the greatest players and coaches in the world throughout history. / Испанската баскетболна лига е основана през 1957 г. като Национална лига и получава настоящия си формат през 1983 г., когато организацията ACB поема контрола над състезанието. Според точкуването Лига ACB е една от трите най-добри европейски лиги. В момента в лигата участват 18 отбора, които играят помежду си два пъти през сезона. Отборът с най-много спечелени титли е Реал Мадрид, но плътно следван от Барселона. Испанското първенство ни даде някои от най-великите играчи и треньори в света през цялата история.

programme.desc: With our home - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) Council of talented women, two strong music stories and two new singles! We know one from theater boards and dora, the other from Voice, music studios - and perhaps hospital corridors. Our guest is Irma Dragicevic, and with her Ana Siric! Another interesting series begins on HRT - remember to leave a review. What are the hidden sides of Croatian tourism and can social networks and reviews form a reputation of destinations? The answers are made by the authors of the series - producer Rea Rajcic and director Ivan Grgur. And we also bring news that has delighted fans around the world - probably the most popular pop star of today, Taylor Swift, has released a new album The Life of a Showgirl. Twelve new songs are already demolishing records, and we bring details about the album and the audience's reactions. R .: Camelia Čančarević ... / Kod nas doma - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) vije talentirane žene, dvije snažne glazbene priče i dva nova singla! Jednu poznajemo s kazališnih dasaka i Dore, drugu s Voicea, glazbenih studija - a možda i bolničkih hodnika. Naša gošća je Irma Dragičević, a s njom i Ana Širić! Na HRT-u počinje još jedan zanimljiv serijal - Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju. Koje su skrivene strane hrvatskog turizma i mogu li društvene mreže i recenzije oblikovati reputaciju destinacija? Odgovore donose autori serijala - producentica Rea Rajčić i redatelj Ivan Grgur. A donosimo i vijest koja je oduševila fanove diljem svijeta - vjerojatno najpopularnija pop zvijezda današnjice, Taylor Swift, objavila je novi album The Life of a Showgirl. programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2016) On the southwestern edge of Petrova Polje, at the foot of the Promine Mountain, Siverić housed. More than a century and a half - until the 1970s - was a prosperous place whose main economic flywheel was a coal mine. The mine is gone, and the time when there was a different one in Siverić, it will speak family memories today, almost miraculously saved after turbulent events during the 20th century, wars, persecution, as well as emotional, nostalgic saying that few remaining residents who, despite everything, want to remember only happy days. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2016) Na jugozapadnom rubu Petrova polja, u podnožju planine Promine, smjestio se Siverić. Više od stoljeća i pol - sve do sedamdesetih godina prošloga stoljeća - bio je prosperitetno mjesto kojemu je glavni gospodarski zamašnjak bio rudnik ugljena. Rudnika više nema, a o vremenu kad se u Siveriću živjelo drugačije nego danas progovorit će obiteljske uspomene, gotovo čudom spašene nakon turbulentnih događaja tijekom 20. stoljeća, ratova, progonstva, kao i emotivna, nostalgična kazivanja ono malo preostalih stanovnika koji, unatoč svemu, žele pamtiti samo sretne dane. R.: Luka Marotti...

And is exponentially more powerful, more dangerous and more destructive than any terminator who came before him. But this time, Connor is not the only target on Skynet's outburst - veterinarian Kate Brewster (Claire Danes), who has nothing to suspect, awaits a collision of an ancient past, the present that promises and the unimaginable future ... but only if he manages to get an unstoppable T -X terminal. Sada 22-godišnjak, Connor živi izvan sustava - nema dom, nema kreditne kartice, nema telefon i nema posao. Nema zapisa o njegovu postojanju. Nema šanse da ga Skynet pronađe. programme.title: Andrija Matijaš Pauk / Andrija Matijaš Pauk
programme.desc: Andrija Matijaš Pauk - (Doc. Film, Croatia) Andrija Matijaš Pauk is a hero and a legend of the Homeland War. This is especially true of the southern front line from Dubrovnik and Zadar, to great tanks in storms and final operations. The tragic death of the penultimate day of the war in the approaches Mrkonjic made the legend even greater. "His" 4th HV Guards Brigade has been named - Spiders since then. Dark Darko Dovranic's documentary shows the life of Andrew Matijaš. It is logical that most of the film is dedicated to the war time, because in the most difficult moments and recognize the biggest heroes. The spider is testified by his fellow soldiers, but also Mother Anka and wife Nada, who decided to donate to the state's legacy to the state to guard. With the abundance of archival shots, this documentary testifies to the greatness and victim of man. R .: Darko Dovranic ... / Andrija Matijaš Pauk - (dok. film, Hrvatska) Andrija Matijaš Pauk junak je i legenda Domovinskog rata. Posebno se to odnosi na južnu bojišnicu od Dubrovnika i Zadra, do sjajnog vođenja tenkova u Oluji i završnim operacijama. Tragična pogibija predzadnjeg dana rata na prilazima Mrkonjić Gradu legendu je učinila još i većom. "Njegova" 4. gardijska brigada HV otada si je dodala naziv - Pauci. Dokumentarni film Darka Dovranića prikazuje život Andrije Matijaša. Logično je da je najveći dio filma posvećen ratnom vremenu, jer se u najtežim trenutcima i prepoznaju najveći junaci. O Pauku svjedoče njegovi suborci, ali i majka Anka i supruga Nada koja je Paukovu ostavštinu odlučila pokloniti državi na čuvanje. programme.title: Sweet Irma / Slatka Irma
programme.desc: Irma La Douce - (Comedy, USA, 1963) Comedy. At five in the morning, everyone in Paris is sleeping except the market employee, prostitutes on Casanova Street and a cafe visitors on that street. In the cafe, owned by Moustache (L. Jacobi), is also settled by a police officer-Pororian who, for a permanent "salary", blinks at the fact that prostitutes are not properly "registered". The most beautiful prostitute is the "sweet" Irma (S. Maclaine), to which a naive new police officer-Pororic Nestor Patou (J. Lemmon) will run into his first morning. It takes a little longer to realize Nestor to realize that the girls standing on the street and taking men to the hotel "Casanova" prostitutes. He does not know that everyone lives in "idylls" - both underwater and prostitutes and police officers, and spends raid at the hotel. Among the "customers" is his chief, Inspector Lefevre (H. Bernardi), who kicked him out of work. Nestor stops at a cafe near Moustache, and there in one conflict of the Irma's "protector" of Hippolyte (B. Yarnell). From now on, she has a new "protector", Nestor, who falls in love with her head ... "Irma La Douce" was a Brodvej musical that Billy Wilder adapted with his permanent associate I. A. L. Diamando in a "sentimental comedy without dance and singing". The music was composed by Andre Previn, who got an Oscar. Faithful Wilder associate Alexandre Trauner imagined and built a beautiful Paris scenery, and J. Lemmon and especially S. Maclaine as Irma are great. Many critics described this movie as "Adult Fairytale." R .: Billy Wilder Ul.: Jack Lemmon (Lord X / Nestor Patou), Shirley Maclaine (Irma), Lou Jacobi (Moustache), Bruce Yarnell (Hippolyte), Herschel Bernardi (Inspector Lefevre) ... / Irma la Douce - (komedija, SAD, 1963) Komedija. U pet ujutro u Parizu svi spavaju osim zaposlenika tržnice, prostitutki u ulici Casanova i posjetitelja kafića u toj ulici. U kafić, čiji je vlasnik Moustache (L. Jacobi), zalazi i policajac-pozornik koji za stalnu "plaću" žmiri na činjenicu da prostitutke nisu propisno "registrirane". Najljepša je prostitutka "Slatka" Irma (S. MacLaine) na koju će svog prvog radnog jutra naletjeti naivni novi policajac-pozornik Nestor Patou (J. Lemmon). Nestoru treba malo dulje kako bi shvatio da su djevojke koje stoje na ulici i odvode muškarce u hotelčić "Casanova" prostitutke. On ne zna da svi žive u "idili" - i podvodači i prostitutke i policajci, pa provede raciju u hotelu. Među "mušterijama" je i njegov šef, inspektor Lefevre (H. Bernardi), koji ga izbaci s posla. Nestor svrati u kafić kod Moustachea i tu u jednom sukobu premlati Irminog "zaštitnika" Hippolytea (B. Yarnell). Ona odsad ima novog "zaštitnika", Nestora, koji se u nju zaljubi preko glave... "Irma la Douce" bio je brodvejski mjuzikl koji je Billy Wilder adaptirao sa svojim stalnim suradnikom I. A. L. Diamondom u "sentimentalnu komediju bez plesa i pjevanja". Glazbu je skladao Andre Previn koji je za to dobio Oscara. Vjerni Wilderov suradnik Alexandre Trauner zamislio je i izgradio prekrasnu parišku scenografiju, a J. Lemmon i osobito S. MacLaine kao Irma sjajni su. Mnogi su kritičari opisali ovaj film kao "bajku za odrasle". R.: Billy Wilder Ul.: Jack Lemmon (Lord X / Nestor Patou), Shirley MacLaine (Irma), Lou Jacobi (Moustache), Bruce Yarnell (Hippolyte), Herschel Bernardi (Inspektor Lefevre)...

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: The story of reality and fantasy - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. R .: Ljiljana Šišmanović ... / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života. R.: Ljiljana Šišmanović...

programme.title: A cloud in the service of the law / Oblak u službi zakona
programme.desc: A cloud in the service of the law - (S03, E04, SUM series, Croatia, 2025) After the hosting, you will be deserved, screenwriters Snježana and Goran Tribuson have prepared a new treat, a family humorous series - a cloud in the Law Service. It is a combination of family series with a slight crime plot, because Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), the head of the Oblak family, is a police sergeant. He is an idealist and honesty who believes in some human values ​​and often recognizes them where they are gone. Unlike Nikola, other members of the Oblak family are far more realistic and more prone to procedures that, although benign, are on the verge of law. Nikola's wife Strawberry (Dijana Vidusin) cannot find a job, and in order to contribute to a small home budget, she often resorts to black work. Creative, curious, somewhat self -sacrificing, devoted herself to Nicholas and children and is the complete opposite of neighbors, butcher shops (Ksenija Marinkovic). Two of their sons, Bruno (Toma Medvesek) and Ratko (Borna Fadljevic), adolescents, are a source of many problems. The younger, Ratko, intellectually superior to everyone in the house while for the elder Bruno, who is by no means finished school, could not say that. Most of the time Bruno spends in a local birtia near Suvi (Zoran Cubrilo) and Ludviga (Goran Navojec) who, although older, do not differ too much from him. Different characters and preferences of family members are a source of humorous situations and complications, and in every episode Nikola is resolved by one criminal case: a kiosk breakthrough, a car theft, a breakthrough of the Kindergarten, a small fraud ... but although in the business a more successful, more intelligent and better police officer than his partner Pozgaja (Igor Mesin) Police tasks, as well as from the head of Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), is in no way progressing in the police hierarchy ... R.: Drazen Žarković Ul.: Dora Fišter, Dijana Vidušin, Magdalena Živaljić Tadić, Igor Mesin, Ljubo Zecevic (neighbor next to Dida's hut) / Oblak u službi zakona - (S03, E04, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon uspješnice Odmori se, zaslužio si, scenaristi Snježana i Goran Tribuson pripremili su nam novu poslasticu, obiteljsku humorističnu seriju - Oblak u službi zakona. Spoj je to obiteljske serije s laganim krimi zapletom, jer Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), glava obitelji Oblak, policijski je narednik. Idealist je i poštenjačina koji vjeruje u neke ljudske vrijednosti te ih nerijetko prepoznaje i tamo gdje ih nema. Za razliku od Nikole, drugi članovi obitelji Oblak daleko su realističniji i skloniji postupcima koji su, iako benigni, na rubu zakonitosti. Nikolina žena Jagoda (Dijana Vidušin) ne može naći posao, a kako bi pridonijela ionako malom kućnom budžetu, često pribjegava radu na crno. Kreativna, znatiželjna, pomalo samozatajna, posvetila se Nikoli i djeci te je potpuna suprotnost susjedi, mesarici Greti (Ksenija Marinković). Dvojica njihovih sinova, Bruno (Toma Medvešek) i Ratko (Borna Fadljević), adolescenti, izvor su mnogih problema. Mlađi, Ratko, intelektualno je nadmoćan svima u kući dok se za starijeg Brunu, koji nikako da završi školu, to ne bi moglo reći. Većinu vremena Bruno provodi u lokalnoj birtiji kod Suvog (Zoran Čubrilo) i Ludviga (Goran Navojec) koji se, iako stariji, ne razlikuju previše od njega. Različiti karakteri i sklonosti članova obitelji Oblak izvor su humornih situacija i zapleta, a u svakoj epizodi Nikola rješava i jedan kriminalistički slučaj: provalu u kiosk, krađu automobila, provalu u kvartovski dječji vrtić, sitne prevare... programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E02, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) It is known to little that the geological material of Earth's crust in the territory of Croatia reflects origin from two continents: European and African. Only a small part of Croatia belongs to the old European use. The beginning of our journey with Medvednica is the border zone of African, that is, the Adriatic microplog and the Eurasian slab. It is here that this tectonic border and zone of the collision of these two plates. The study of the geological material of Medvednica is started along its northwest edge, on a seismogenous fault that was the causative agent of the last Zagreb earthquake on March 2, 2020. After that, we get acquainted with the rocks of this mountain that differ in the type, composition, way and place of Genesis. In the word, it will really be boring here and uniformly talking to the rocks. In the mystical landscape of the abandoned Upper Bistra Mine, we discover unusual stone pillows, pillow lava or pillow lava. These findings represent the rest of the former Oceanic area called Neotetthys and thus geologically follow where this ocean was located at the time of the Mesozoik, in the Triassic period 250 million years ago. Following the traces in the rocks woven in Medvedgrad's walls, we explore the geological heritage of Medvednica from the Paleozoic period all the way to the rocks of only 16 million years old, such as the most famous - lithotamnian limestone from which the Zagreb cathedral was built. We travel to a period of warm mycene about 12 million years ago, when Medvednica was mostly surrounded by water and occasionally emerged as an island in the sea of ​​paratetitis. We will also visit the Veternica Cave created by the action of the water for millions of years. The water path leads us a little more west, to the Žumberak Nature Park. The story of the Triassic Dolomites that prevail here is located in the period 240 million years ago. In Samobor Highlands, we will enter the mine of St. Barbara, the only place in Croatia where you can see the Siderit mineral. With the return to Medvedgrad, we round out this journey enriched with knowledge ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E02, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Malokome je poznato kako geološka građa Zemljine kore na području Hrvatske odražava podrijetlo iz dvaju kontinenata: europskog i afričkog. Staroj europskoj kori pripada samo manji dio Hrvatske. Početak našeg putovanja Medvednicom je granična zona Afričke, odnosno Jadranske mikroploče i Euroazijske ploče. Upravo je ovdje ta tektonska granica i zona sudara tih dviju ploča. Istraživanje geološke građe Medvednice započinjemo uz njezin sjeverozapadni rub, na seizmogenom rasjedu koji je bio uzročnikom zadnjeg zagrebačkog potresa 22. ožujka 2020. godine. Nakon toga upoznajemo se sa stijenama ove planine koje se razlikuju po vrsti, sastavu, načinu i mjestu postanka. Riječju, ovdje zbilja neće biti dosadno i jednolično razgovarati sa stijenama. Ovi nalazi predstavljaju ostatak nekadašnjeg oceanskoga prostora koji se zvao Neotethys i tako geološki pratimo gdje se taj ocean nalazio u vrijeme mezozoika, u razdoblju trijasa prije 250 milijuna godina. Slijedeći tragove u stijenama utkanih u zidine Medvedgrada, istražujemo geološku baštinu Medvednice od razdoblja paleozoika sve do stijena starih tek nekih 16 milijuna godina, poput najpoznatijeg - litotamnijskog vapnenca od kojeg je sagrađena i Zagrebačka katedrala. Putujemo do razdoblja toploga miocena prije oko 12 milijuna godina, kada je Medvednica većinom bila okružena vodom i povremeno izranjala kao otok u moru Paratetis. Posjetit ćemo i špilju Veternicu nastalu djelovanjem vode tijekom milijuna godina. Put vode vodi nas malo zapadnije, u Park prirode Žumberak. Priča o trijaskim dolomitima koji ovdje prevladavaju smještena je u razdoblje prije 240 milijuna godina. U Samoborskom gorju, ući ćemo u rudnik Sv. Barbara, jedino mjesto u Hrvatskoj gdje možete vidjeti mineral siderit. Povratkom na Medvedgrad zaokružujemo ovo putovanje obogaćeni spozna...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E02, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) It is known to little that the geological material of Earth's crust in the territory of Croatia reflects origin from two continents: European and African. Only a small part of Croatia belongs to the old European use. The beginning of our journey with Medvednica is the border zone of African, that is, the Adriatic microplog and the Eurasian slab. It is here that this tectonic border and zone of the collision of these two plates. The study of the geological material of Medvednica is started along its northwest edge, on a seismogenous fault that was the causative agent of the last Zagreb earthquake on March 2, 2020. After that, we get acquainted with the rocks of this mountain that differ in the type, composition, way and place of Genesis. In the word, it will really be boring here and uniformly talking to the rocks. In the mystical landscape of the abandoned Upper Bistra Mine, we discover unusual stone pillows, pillow lava or pillow lava. These findings represent the rest of the former Oceanic area called Neotetthys and thus geologically follow where this ocean was located at the time of the Mesozoik, in the Triassic period 250 million years ago. Following the traces in the rocks woven in Medvedgrad's walls, we explore the geological heritage of Medvednica from the Paleozoic period all the way to the rocks of only 16 million years old, such as the most famous - lithotamnian limestone from which the Zagreb cathedral was built. We travel to a period of warm mycene about 12 million years ago, when Medvednica was mostly surrounded by water and occasionally emerged as an island in the sea of ​​paratetitis. We will also visit the Veternica Cave created by the action of the water for millions of years. The water path leads us a little more west, to the Žumberak Nature Park. The story of the Triassic Dolomites that prevail here is located in the period 240 million years ago. In Samobor Highlands, we will enter the mine of St. Barbara, the only place in Croatia where you can see the Siderit mineral. With the return to Medvedgrad, we round out this journey enriched with knowledge ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E02, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Malokome je poznato kako geološka građa Zemljine kore na području Hrvatske odražava podrijetlo iz dvaju kontinenata: europskog i afričkog. Staroj europskoj kori pripada samo manji dio Hrvatske. Početak našeg putovanja Medvednicom je granična zona Afričke, odnosno Jadranske mikroploče i Euroazijske ploče. Upravo je ovdje ta tektonska granica i zona sudara tih dviju ploča. Istraživanje geološke građe Medvednice započinjemo uz njezin sjeverozapadni rub, na seizmogenom rasjedu koji je bio uzročnikom zadnjeg zagrebačkog potresa 22. ožujka 2020. godine. Nakon toga upoznajemo se sa stijenama ove planine koje se razlikuju po vrsti, sastavu, načinu i mjestu postanka. Riječju, ovdje zbilja neće biti dosadno i jednolično razgovarati sa stijenama. U mističnom krajoliku napuštenoga rudnika Gornja Bistra otkrivamo neobične kamene jastuke, pillow lave ili jastučaste lave. Ovi nalazi predstavljaju ostatak nekadašnjeg oceanskoga prostora koji se zvao Neotethys i tako geološki pratimo gdje se taj ocean nalazio u vrijeme mezozoika, u razdoblju trijasa prije 250 milijuna godina. Slijedeći tragove u stijenama utkanih u zidine Medvedgrada, istražujemo geološku baštinu Medvednice od razdoblja paleozoika sve do stijena starih tek nekih 16 milijuna godina, poput najpoznatijeg - litotamnijskog vapnenca od kojeg je sagrađena i Zagrebačka katedrala. Putujemo do razdoblja toploga miocena prije oko 12 milijuna godina, kada je Medvednica većinom bila okružena vodom i povremeno izranjala kao otok u moru Paratetis. Posjetit ćemo i špilju Veternicu nastalu djelovanjem vode tijekom milijuna godina. Put vode vodi nas malo zapadnije, u Park prirode Žumberak. Priča o trijaskim dolomitima koji ovdje prevladavaju smještena je u razdoblje prije 240 milijuna godina. U Samoborskom gorju, ući ćemo u rudnik Sv. Barbara, jedino mjesto u Hrvatskoj gdje možete vidjeti mineral siderit. Povratkom na Medvedgrad zaokružujemo ovo putovanje obogaćeni spozna...

programme.title: Ugly, dirty, evil / Ružni, prljavi, zli
programme.desc: Brutti, Podochi e Cattiva - (Comedy, Italy, 1976) in a poor Roman suburbs, a number of Giazint Mazatelle (N. Manfredi) family lives in a cost barracks on a hill. In addition to his wife, Matilda (L. Moretti), with one -eyed Giazinth under the same roof, four generations of his family, ten children, closer and further relatives and his old and demented mother, live under the same roof. Giazinto is a too arrogant man who, in humiliating ways and with the contempt, relates to the household, who deal with tiny crime, prostitution and other illegal affairs. Giazinto lost his eye at one job, which is why the state decides to pay him a million lira in compensation. Of course, he does not intend to share that money with the rest of the family, but spends a part on himself and part of the household. This will, in turn, make the other household to start making up different ways to get money. And when he brings the young mistress Iside (M. L. Santella) to the house one day, and when he forces his wife to divide the bed in three, Matilda will start to forge plans for Giazint's poisoning with the rest of the family. R .: Ettore Scola Ul.: Nino Manfredi (Giacinto), Maria Luisa Santell (Iside), Francesco Anniballi (Domizio), Franco Merli (Fernando), Maria Bosco (Gaetana) ... / Brutti, sporchi e cattivi - (komedija, Italija, 1976) U siromašnom rimskom predgrađu, u trošnim barakama na brežuljku živi brojna obitelj Giazinta Mazatelle (N. Manfredi). Pored supruge Matilde (L. Moretti), s jednookim Giazintom pod istim krovom žive četiri generacije njegove obitelji, desetoro djece, bliža i daljnja rodbina te njegova stara i dementna majka. Giazinto je prijek i arogantan čovjek koji se na ponižavajuće načine i s prijezirom odnosi prema ukućanima, koji se bave sitnim kriminalom, prostitucijom i drugim nezakonitim poslovima. Giazinto je na jednom poslu svojedobno izgubio oko, zbog čega mu država u znak odštete odluči isplatiti milijun lira. Dakako, on taj novac ne namjerava podijeliti s ostatkom obitelji, već dio potroši na sebe a dio sakrije od ukućana. To će pak ostale ukućane nagnati da počnu smišljati različite načine kako bi se domogli novca. A kad on jednog dana u kuću dovede mladu ljubavnicu Iside (M. L. Santella), te kad suprugu prisili da postelju dijele u troje, Matilda će s ostatkom obitelji početi kovati planove za Giazintovo trovanje. programme.title: What time is it? / Koliko je sati?
programme.desc: Che o o è? - (Drama, Italy, 1989) The film follows the relationship of the father and son who meet again after a long time. The son, a young soldier, spends his day off with his father, a lawyer from Rome, in the small town of Civitavecchia. Through their conversations and walks, different life philosophy gradually reveals: the father is successful, but a little cold and prone to rationalization, while the son strives for a simpler, emotional approach to life. The film explores the generation gap, lost closeness and the question of how much parent and child really know each other, with a dose of irony and tenderness typical of Scol. R .: Ettore Scola Ul.: Marcello Mastroianni (Marcello, The Father), Massimo Troisi (Michele, The Son), Anne Parillaud (Loredana), Renato Moretti (Sor Pietro), Lou Castel (Fisherman) ... / Che ora è? - (drama, Italija, 1989) Film prati odnos oca i sina koji se ponovno susreću nakon dugo vremena. Sin, mladi vojnik, provodi slobodan dan s ocem, odvjetnikom iz Rima, u malom gradu Civitavecchia. Kroz njihove razgovore i šetnje postupno se otkrivaju različite životne filozofije: otac je uspješan, ali pomalo hladan i sklon racionaliziranju, dok sin teži jednostavnijem, emotivnijem pristupu životu. Film istražuje generacijski jaz, izgubljenu bliskost i pitanje koliko se roditelj i dijete doista poznaju, uz dozu ironije i nježnosti tipične za Scolu. R.: Ettore Scola Ul.: Marcello Mastroianni (Marcello, The Father), Massimo Troisi (Michele, the son), Anne Parillaud (Loredana), Renato Moretti (Sor Pietro), Lou Castel (Fisherman)...

Through series of numerous portraits, picturesque daily records to the choice of seemingly bizarre and simple motives, we discover the magical about the author of a clear artistic attitude, prone to marginal but daily things and phenomena, poetry of the details, the surprise that is around us, but should be recognized, seen and shown. R.: Vladimir Kleščić ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2000) Boris Cvjetanović, jedan od najboljih hrvatskih suvremenih fotografa, autor je čiji rad zasluženo uživa iznimno poštovanje i u svjetskim okvirima. Preko serija brojnih portreta, slikovitih dnevničkih zapisa do izbora naoko bizarnih i jednostavnih motiva, otkrivamo čarobno oko autora jasnog umjetničkog stava, sklonog marginalnim ali svakodnevnim stvarima i pojavama, poeziji detalja, začudnostima koje se nalaze posvuda oko nas, ali ih treba prepoznati, vidjeti i pokazati. R.: Vladimir Kleščić...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E03, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) Velebit, our longest mountain, 145 kilometers long, leaves no one indifferent to anyone. But her geological story is also astonishing, to the laymen, sometimes confusing, and to scientists, geologists who study her and today raises a number of new questions and the need for new research. In this story, we explore that the rocks, which mostly build Velebit, created in the shallow sea on the edge of the equatorial belt of Prakontinent Pangeja, found nearly five thousand kilometers of northeast. We are embarking on a big trip, which lasted 300 million years. We start at Zavizan, then through the northern slopes of Velebit in the mountain settlement, we visit the headquarters of the North Velebit National Park. At the Krasno Visitors Center, in a professional and attractive exhibition, we are most interested in the geological past of the mountain, the animated film vividly describes the creation of the Sleelbit of Sea shallows to this day. It's a great starting point for a tour. It has been beautiful since ancient times for pilgrimage visits to the Marian shrine. This is a good starting point for us to go on a pilgrimage to the distant geological past. And at once, in the period of carbon, there are numerous forms of foraminifera, corals, ammoniti, trilling in the seas. With the help of the Paleontologist and we find the fossils of these organisms over 300 million years old. On the Lika side of Velebit, we move to the middle part of the Velebit Nature Park, we are now in the Perm period, huge fern, horsetail, in the sea there are numerous organisms. We discover fossils of marine organisms that lived in the shallow sea, along the edge of the African continent 250 million years ago. Traveling by geological periods, half between Lika and the sea side of Velebit, we arrive at the border of Triassic and Jure. The rocks are rich in microphosils, but also the fossils of visible and naked eye. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E03, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Velebit, naša najduža planina, duga 145 kilometara, svojom ljepotom nikoga ne ostavlja ravnodušnim. No, njena je geološka priča također zapanjujuća, laicima ponekad zbunjujuća, a znanstvenicima, geolozima koji je proučavaju i danas otvara brojna nova pitanja i potrebu za novim istraživanjima. U ovoj priči istražujemo kako su se stijene, koje najvećim dijelom grade Velebit, nastale u plitkome moru na rubu ekvatorijalnoga pojasa prakontinenta Pangeje, našle gotovo pet tisuća kilometara sjevernoistočnije. Krećemo na veliko putovanje koje je trajalo 300 milijuna godina. Počinjemo na Zavižanu, pa preko sjevernih obronaka Velebita u planinskom naselju Krasno posjećujemo sjedište Nacionalnog parka Sjeverni Velebit. U Centru za posjetitelje Krasno, u stručnom i atraktivnom postavu, najviše nas zanima geološka prošlost planine, animirani film zorno opisuje stvaranje Velebita od morskih plićaka do danas. To je odlična početna točka za obilazak. Krasno je od davnina poznato po hodočasničkim posjetima marijanskom svetištu. To nam je dobra početna točka da krenemo na hodočašće dalekom geološkom prošlošću. I odjednom smo u razdoblju karbona, u morima žive brojni oblici foraminifera, koralji, amoniti, trilobiti. Uz pomoć paleontologinja i mi nalazimo fosile tih organizama starih više od 300 milijuna godina. S ličke strane Velebita prebacujemo se u srednji dio Parka prirode Velebit, sada smo u razdoblju perma, prevladavaju goleme papratnjače, preslice, u moru žive brojni organizmi. Otkrivamo fosile morskih organizama koji su obitavali u plitkom moru, uz rub afričkoga kontinenta prije 250 milijuna godina. Putujući geološkim razdobljima, na polovici između ličke i morske strane Velebita, stižemo na granicu trijasa i jure. Stijene su bogate mikrofosilima, ali i fosilima vidljivih i golim okom. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: As it is said - (E11, Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The HTV Education and Science Department in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute has recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as young people and foreign words in Croatian are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts at the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec ... / Kako se kaže - (E11, show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E03, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) Velebit, our longest mountain, 145 kilometers long, leaves no one indifferent to anyone. But her geological story is also astonishing, to the laymen, sometimes confusing, and to scientists, geologists who study her and today raises a number of new questions and the need for new research. In this story, we explore that the rocks, which mostly build Velebit, created in the shallow sea on the edge of the equatorial belt of Prakontinent Pangeja, found nearly five thousand kilometers of northeast. We are embarking on a big trip, which lasted 300 million years. We start at Zavizan, then through the northern slopes of Velebit in the mountain settlement, we visit the headquarters of the North Velebit National Park. At the Krasno Visitors Center, in a professional and attractive exhibition, we are most interested in the geological past of the mountain, the animated film vividly describes the creation of the Sleelbit of Sea shallows to this day. It's a great starting point for a tour. It has been beautiful since ancient times for pilgrimage visits to the Marian shrine. This is a good starting point for us to go on a pilgrimage to the distant geological past. And at once, in the period of carbon, there are numerous forms of foraminifera, corals, ammoniti, trilling in the seas. With the help of the Paleontologist and we find the fossils of these organisms over 300 million years old. On the Lika side of Velebit, we move to the middle part of the Velebit Nature Park, we are now in the Perm period, huge fern, horsetail, in the sea there are numerous organisms. We discover fossils of marine organisms that lived in the shallow sea, along the edge of the African continent 250 million years ago. Traveling by geological periods, half between Lika and the sea side of Velebit, we arrive at the border of Triassic and Jure. The rocks are rich in microphosils, but also the fossils of visible and naked eye. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E03, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Velebit, naša najduža planina, duga 145 kilometara, svojom ljepotom nikoga ne ostavlja ravnodušnim. No, njena je geološka priča također zapanjujuća, laicima ponekad zbunjujuća, a znanstvenicima, geolozima koji je proučavaju i danas otvara brojna nova pitanja i potrebu za novim istraživanjima. U ovoj priči istražujemo kako su se stijene, koje najvećim dijelom grade Velebit, nastale u plitkome moru na rubu ekvatorijalnoga pojasa prakontinenta Pangeje, našle gotovo pet tisuća kilometara sjevernoistočnije. Krećemo na veliko putovanje koje je trajalo 300 milijuna godina. Počinjemo na Zavižanu, pa preko sjevernih obronaka Velebita u planinskom naselju Krasno posjećujemo sjedište Nacionalnog parka Sjeverni Velebit. U Centru za posjetitelje Krasno, u stručnom i atraktivnom postavu, najviše nas zanima geološka prošlost planine, animirani film zorno opisuje stvaranje Velebita od morskih plićaka do danas. To je odlična početna točka za obilazak. Krasno je od davnina poznato po hodočasničkim posjetima marijanskom svetištu. To nam je dobra početna točka da krenemo na hodočašće dalekom geološkom prošlošću. I odjednom smo u razdoblju karbona, u morima žive brojni oblici foraminifera, koralji, amoniti, trilobiti. Uz pomoć paleontologinja i mi nalazimo fosile tih organizama starih više od 300 milijuna godina. S ličke strane Velebita prebacujemo se u srednji dio Parka prirode Velebit, sada smo u razdoblju perma, prevladavaju goleme papratnjače, preslice, u moru žive brojni organizmi. Otkrivamo fosile morskih organizama koji su obitavali u plitkom moru, uz rub afričkoga kontinenta prije 250 milijuna godina. Putujući geološkim razdobljima, na polovici između ličke i morske strane Velebita, stižemo na granicu trijasa i jure. Stijene su bogate mikrofosilima, ali i fosilima vidljivih i golim okom. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

programme.title: Visiting Fortuni / U posjetu Fortuni
programme.desc: Fortuna Vendegei - (Doc. Film, Hungary, 2022) The documentary film is a modern fairy tale with a happy ending. We follow the story of a colorful Hungarian married couple, Aniko and Lacia. The two of them until 2013 lived a difficult life, marked by numerous traumas that had largely stemmed from poverty. However, they were happy, and their lives were filled with mutual understanding and imagination about distant travel. In 2013, they smiled happiness when Laci won two million euros in the lottery, which is why their life changes abruptly. For her, money meant that he could finally be dedicated to entrepreneurship and embarks on different investments. For him, the goal meant that he no longer had to work and that he could make his dreams of traveling and discovering the world. This contrary to the understanding of material wealth puts their harmonious relationship to a great trial and slowly begin to separate. Will their marriage endure the burden of sudden wealth? R .: Matyas Kalman Ul.: Aniko Andraschek (Self), Lászlo Andraschek (Self) ... / Fortuna vendegei - (dok. film, Mađarska, 2022) Dokumentarni film u svojoj je srži moderna bajka sa sretnim završetkom. Međutim, bili su sretni, a život im je bio ispunjen međusobnim razumijevanjem i maštanjem o dalekim putovanjima. Te 2013. godine im se osmjehnula sreća kada je Laci osvojio dva milijuna eura na lutriji, zbog čega im se život naglo mijenja. Za nju, novac je značio da se napokon može posvetiti poduzetništvu te kreće u različita ulaganja. Za njega, zgoditak je značio da više ne mora raditi te da može ostvariti svoje snove o putovanjima i otkrivanju svijeta. Ovakvo suprotno poimanje materijalnog bogatstva stavlja njihov skladan odnos na veliku kušnju te se polako počinju razdvajati. Hoće li njihov brak izdržati teret iznenadnog bogatstva? programme.title: This is philosophy / Ovo je filozofija
programme.desc: This is Philosophy - (E01, Educational Program, Spain), in ancient Greece, from her desire for knowledge, philosophy was born. The philosophers known as the pre -Socrates asked the question that is still unanswered today: how is it possible for things to change and remain the same at the same time? Tales, Anaximen, Anaximanda and Pythagoras, all of them tried to answer that question. The Heraclitus, the defender of the change, and the Parmenide, who claimed that the being remains the same, and the change is a mere illusion. It is a fight that continues to last. In order to better understand her, we talk to philosophers Simon Blackburn and Victor Gomez Pin and musician Ramon Gener. R .: Oriol Jara ... / This is Philosophy - (E01, obrazovni program, Španjolska) U antičkoj se Grčkoj iz želje za znanjem rodila filozofija. Filozofi poznati kao predsokratovci postavljali su pitanje koje je i danas bez odgovora: kako je moguće da se stvari mijenjaju i istodobno ostaju iste? Tales, Anaksimen, Anaksimandar i Pitagora, svi su oni pokušali odgovoriti na to pitanje. Pokušali su i Heraklit, branitelj promjene, i Parmenid, koji je tvrdio da biće ostaje isto, a promjena je puka iluzija. Borba je to koja i dalje traje. Kako bismo je bolje razumjeli, razgovaramo s filozofima Simonom Blackburnom i Victorom Gomezom Pinom te s glazbenikom Ramonom Generom. R.: Oriol Jara...

programme.desc: One work - (S08, E09, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) The complex of today's "Technical Museum of Nikola Tesla" in Zagreb was built in 1949 for the needs of the Zagreb Fair. Zbog brzine izgradnje cijela je zgrada izvedena u drvenoj konstrukciji i obložena drvetom. Krovni nosači i rešetkasti stupovi, kao i kovani spojni dijelovi izrađivani su usporedno s montažom konstrukcije na gradilištu, a cijela je konstrukcija iznimno čvrsta i stabilna...

programme.title: Let's take you ... Zagreb Classic / Vodimo vas ... Zagreb Classic
programme.desc: ZAGREB CLASSIC - (Movie Klas. Music, Croatia, 2025) The eighth Zagreb Classic Festival was held from June 19 to July 2, 2025. At King Tomislav Square, and the celebration of music under the clear sky on June 22 of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Choir with a thematic concert called the Summer of the Mediterranean. Mediterranean sun-bathed melodies, fiery rhythms, sea blue, irresistible charm and temperament that erupts from each clock are the backbone of the concert of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Assembly under the guidance of one of the most prominent directions of the younger generation on the European scene, Gergely Duboczki. Educated at the Franz Liszt Academy in Budapest, highlighted as a creator of a series of contemporary and multican productions, now joined with HRT ensembles and excellent Croatian soloists who build great international careers. Violinist Sara Domjanic arrived from Germany, where she operates as the second concert master Dusseldorf symphonics, Split Tenor Tomislav Jukic is among the last successes engaging with Cecilia Bartoli on the main stage of the Opera in Zurich, and Bas-Bariton Benjamin Šuran recently performed on the Festival. Baden-Baden with the Berlin Philharmonic and Kirill Petrenka. The program leads us from Spain and Italy to Dalmatia, starting with Andalusia inspired by Españo Emmanuel Chabrier, through orchestral masterpieces, such as virtuoso introducing and Ronda Capriccios Camille Saint-Saëns and the enthusiastic idylls of Blagoje Bersa Roman-Korsakova. Some of the most beautiful human voice tunes belong to the Italian repertoire, so listen to arias, duets and choirs from the opera Cavalleria Rustican Pietra Mascagni, the love drink of Gaetan Donizetti, and Pagliacci Rugger Leoncavall and from the Operation of the Split aquarel of our Ive Tijardovic. With our favorite cancone Naples - non there più and funiculì, funiculà - bring us a warm, sunny wing of the south of Italy. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Zagreb Classic - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2025) Osmi po redu festival Zagreb Classic održao se od 19. lipnja do 2. srpnja 2025. na Trgu kralja Tomislava, a slavlju glazbe pod vedrim nebom 22. lipnja pridružio se i Simfonijski orkestar te Zbor HRT-a tematskim koncertom pod nazivom Sjaj Mediterana. Mediteranskim suncem okupane melodije, vatreni ritmovi, morsko plavetnilo, neodoljivi šarm i temperament koji izbijaju iz svakoga takta okosnica su koncerta Simfonijskog orkestra i Zbora HRT-a pod vodstvom jednoga od najistaknutijih dirigenata mlađe generacije na europskoj sceni, Gergelya Duboczkog. Školovan na Akademiji Franz Liszt u Budimpešti, istaknut kao kreator niza suvremenih i multižanrovskih produkcija, sada se udružio s ansamblima HRT-a i vrsnim hrvatskim solistima koji grade sjajne međunarodne karijere. Violinistica Sara Domjanić stigla je iz Njemačke gdje djeluje kao druga koncertna majstorica Dusseldorfskih simfoničara, splitski tenor Tomislav Jukić među posljednjim uspjesima bilježi angažman uz Ceciliju Bartoli na glavnoj pozornici Opere u Zurichu, a bas-bariton Benjamin Šuran nedavno je nastupio u produkciji opere Madama Butterfly na Festivalu Baden-Baden uz Berlinsku filharmoniju i Kirilla Petrenka. Program nas vodi od Španjolske i Italije do Dalmacije, počevši od Andaluzijom nadahnute rapsodije España Emmanuela Chabriera, preko orkestralnih remek-djela, poput virtuozne Introdukcije i Ronda capricciosa Camillea Saint-Saënsa i zanosne Idile Blagoja Berse, do strastvene suite Španjolski capriccio Nikolaja Rimski-Korsakova. Neke od najljepših melodija za ljudski glas pripadaju dakako talijanskom repertoaru, pa poslušajte arije, duete i zborove iz opera Cavalleria rusticana Pietra Mascagnija, Ljubavni napitak Gaetana Donizettija, I Pagliacci Ruggera Leoncavalla te iz operete Spliski akvarel našega Ive Tijardovića. Uz omiljene napuljske kancone - Non tamo più i Funiculì, funiculà - donose nam toplo, osunčano okrilje juga Italije. R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.title: All played in Montreux / Svi su svirali u Montreuxu
programme.desc: They All Came Out to Montreux - (Doc. Film, Switzerland, 2021) starting to play music in 1967, practically without any knowledge of the music industry, Claude Nobs turned his dormant hometown on the Lake Geneva Coast into a destination for international music artists. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads ... The list continues, and finally everyone came to Montreux. Claude recorded it all and recorded to the smallest details and created the UNESCO Extraordinary Depth and Quality Archives. From revolutionary performances to stunning and intimate recording of conversations, this film provides an impressive insight into the unique world of Claude Nobs and his love for music. R .: Oliver Murray ... / They All Came Out to Montreux - (dok. film, Švicarska, 2021) Počevši se baviti glazbom 1967. godine, praktički bez ikakvog znanja o glazbenoj industriji, Claude Nobs svoj je uspavani rodni grad na obali Ženevskog jezera pretvarao u odredište za međunarodne glazbene umjetnike. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads... popis se nastavlja, i na kraju su svi došli u Montreux. Claude je sve to snimio i zabilježio do najsitnijih detalja i stvorio UNESCO-vu arhivu izvanredne dubine i kvalitete. Od revolucionarnih nastupa do zapanjujućih i intimnih snimaka razgovora, ovaj film pruža impresivan uvid u jedinstveni svijet Claudea Nobsa i njegove ljubavi prema glazbi. R.: Oliver Murray...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: At the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) in accordance with trends, and money becomes part of the digital world. Through card and internet business, and with the appearance of cryptocurrencies, digital money already exists. But the novelty in this field is to create digital state currency. Currently, as many as 130 countries, which together make up 98 % of the world GDP, explore, develop or already implement digital currencies in its economies. This raises important questions - from the freedom of the choice of the individual and the surrender of the monetary system of private corporations, through the anonymity of the consumption, to the dependence of the constant availability of modern devices, electricity and the Internet. In a comprehensive rush according to the issuance of the digital money of central banks, it is worth noting and trying to understand: what brings with it such money and why is it introduced? ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) U skladu s trendovima, i novac postaje dio digitalnog svijeta. Putem kartičnog i internetskog poslovanja, a i pojavom kriptovaluta, digitalni novac već postoji. No, novost na tom polju jest stvaranje digitalnih državnih valuta. Trenutačno čak 130 zemalja, koje zajedno čine 98 % svjetskog BDP-a, istražuje, razvija ili već implementira digitalne valute u svojim gospodarstvima. Time se otvaraju važna pitanja - od slobode izbora pojedinca i predaje upravljanja monetarnim sustavom privatnim korporacijama, preko anonimnosti potrošnje, pa sve do ovisnosti o stalnoj dostupnosti modernih uređaja, električne energije i interneta. U sveopćoj žurbi prema izdavanju digitalnog novca središnjih banaka, vrijedi zastati i pokušati razumjeti: što sa sobom donosi takav novac i zašto se uvodi?...

programme.title: I wanted to hide / Htio sam se sakriti
programme.desc: The love of Nasconermi - (Drama, Italy, 2020) The story of the painter Antoni Ligabueu, Swiss -Italian origin, with flashbacks depicting pieces of his childhood. After being entrusted with foster parents, he immediately begins to have psychophysical disorders, with rachitis, being kicked out of school and hospitalized several times. At the same time, he finds comfort in painting and sculpture, often portraying exotic animals such as lions, gorillas, tigers, which merges with the Emilian landscape, because Antonio will move to Gualtieri in Emilia Romagni, where they call him "El Tudesc" (German). However, Ligabue soon reveals critic Renato Marino Mazzacurati, who encourages him to continue his work and participate in art exhibitions, until the ligabue is slowly discovered by other critics, although some academics call him a naive artist. R.: Giorgio Diritti Ul.: Elio Germano (Anton Laccabue aka Antonio Ligabue), Oliver Ewy (Antonio Ligabue Ragazzo), Leonardo Carrozzo (Antonio Ligabue Bambino), Pietro Traldi (Renato Marino Mazzacurati), Orietta Notari) ... / Volevo nascondermi - (drama, Italija, 2020) Priča o slikaru Antoniju Ligabueu, švicarsko-talijanskog podrijetla, s flashbackovima koji prikazuju djeliće njegova djetinjstva. Nakon što je kao mali povjeren udomiteljima, odmah počinje imati psihofizičke poremećaje, obolijeva od rahitisa, biva izbačen iz škole i nekoliko puta hospitaliziran. Istodobno, pronalazi utjehu u slikarstvu i kiparstvu, često prikazujući egzotične životinje poput lavova, gorila, tigrova, koje spaja s emilijskim krajolikom, jer će se Antonio preseliti u Gualtieri u Emiliji Romagni, gdje ga pogrdno nazivaju "El Tudesc" (Nijemac). Međutim, Ligabuea ubrzo otkriva kritičar Renato Marino Mazzacurati, koji ga potiče da nastavi s radom i sudjeluje na umjetničkim izložbama, sve dok Ligabuea polako ne otkriju i ostali kritičari, iako ga neki akademici nazivaju naivnim umjetnikom. R.: Giorgio Diritti Ul.: Elio Germano (Anton Laccabue aka Antonio Ligabue), Oliver Ewy (Antonio Ligabue ragazzo), Leonardo Carrozzo (Antonio Ligabue bambino), Pietro Traldi (Renato Marino Mazzacurati), Orietta Notari (Madre di Mazzacurati)...

Mediterranean sun-bathed melodies, fiery rhythms, sea blue, irresistible charm and temperament that erupts from each clock are the backbone of the concert of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Assembly under the guidance of one of the most prominent directions of the younger generation on the European scene, Gergely Duboczki. Educated at the Franz Liszt Academy in Budapest, highlighted as a creator of a series of contemporary and multican productions, now joins with HRT ensembles and excellent Croatian soloists who build great international careers. programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third Age - (Educational Program, Croatia) generation to which we owe the future and which provided us with the present on the International Day of the Elderly, is "honored" by the Government's decision, according to which an annual allowance or colloquially called thirteenth pension will be 6 euros per year. Shocked and disappointed, as they say with this shameful decision, it is a generation that is difficult to break, and with some inexplicable fervor in the reportage of Višnja Ružojčić, they talk about survival from pension to retirement. With sea stories, we sail further through the Doriana Tikveni story show about people who have won championships and medals in various disciplines in diving. The 91-year-old fisherman who does not leave the passion for fishing, Marko Percan brings us the story. And often neglected pensioners and those who care for them were visited by our Split team ... / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Generacija kojoj dugujemo budućnost i koja je nama osigurala sadašnjost na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba "počašćena" je odlukom Vlade prema kojoj će godišnji dodatak ili kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina iznositi 6 eura po godini staža. Šokirani i razočarani, kako kažu ovom sramotnom odlukom, generacija je to koju je teško slomiti, pa s nekim neobjašnjivim žarom u reportaži Višnje Ružojčić govore o preživljavaju od mirovine do mirovine. S morskim pričama plovimo dalje kroz emisiju s pričom Doriane Tikvicki o ljudima koji su u različitim disciplinama u ronjenju osvajali prvenstva i medalje. O 91-godišnjem ribaru kojeg strast za ribarenjem ne napušta, priču nam donosi Marko Percan. A često zanemarene umirovljenike i one o koji njima skrbe, na Visu je posjetila naša splitska ekipa...

programme.desc: My path - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) The new, third season of travel and documentary series My Way is opening a story from Bad Homburg, a city with a maximum of billionaire in Germany. It is also proud of the first European grassy tennis court, the first casinos, an elite spa, an imposing park. They found their place under the sun and Croats in Bad Homburg. programme.title: Andrija Matijaš Pauk / Andrija Matijaš Pauk
programme.desc: Andrija Matijaš Pauk - (Doc. Film, Croatia) Andrija Matijaš Pauk is a hero and a legend of the Homeland War. This is especially true of the southern front line from Dubrovnik and Zadar, to great tanks in storms and final operations. The tragic death of the penultimate day of the war in the approaches Mrkonjic made the legend even greater. "His" 4th HV Guards Brigade has been named - Spiders since then. Dark Darko Dovranic's documentary shows the life of Andrew Matijaš. It is logical that most of the film is dedicated to the war time, because in the most difficult moments and recognize the biggest heroes. The spider is testified by his fellow soldiers, but also Mother Anka and wife Nada, who decided to donate to the state's legacy to the state to guard. With the abundance of archival shots, this documentary testifies to the greatness and victim of man. R .: Darko Dovranic ... / Andrija Matijaš Pauk - (dok. film, Hrvatska) Andrija Matijaš Pauk junak je i legenda Domovinskog rata. Posebno se to odnosi na južnu bojišnicu od Dubrovnika i Zadra, do sjajnog vođenja tenkova u Oluji i završnim operacijama. Tragična pogibija predzadnjeg dana rata na prilazima Mrkonjić Gradu legendu je učinila još i većom. "Njegova" 4. gardijska brigada HV otada si je dodala naziv - Pauci. Dokumentarni film Darka Dovranića prikazuje život Andrije Matijaša. Logično je da je najveći dio filma posvećen ratnom vremenu, jer se u najtežim trenutcima i prepoznaju najveći junaci. O Pauku svjedoče njegovi suborci, ali i majka Anka i supruga Nada koja je Paukovu ostavštinu odlučila pokloniti državi na čuvanje. Uz obilje arhivskih snimaka ovaj dokumentarac svjedoči o veličini i žrtvi Čovjeka. R.: Darko Dovranić...

programme.title: The female / Kvindeligaen
programme.desc: Jysk showdown in the femalea between the two traditional clubs Viborg and Horsens. Viborg has had a turbulent prelude to this season, where the club lost both the coach and the top scorer, but has nevertheless shown great strength. Can the green -blazed from the cathedral city secure a victory against Horsens? / Jysk opgør i kvindeligaen mellem de to traditionsklubber Viborg og Horsens. Viborg har haft en turbulent optakt til denne sæson, hvor klubben mistede både træneren og topscoreren, men har alligevel vist stor styrke. Kan de grønblusede fra domkirkebyen sikre sig en sejr mod Horsens?

Og Danmark stiller stærkt med blandt andre Viktor Axelsen, Rasmus Gemke, Line Kjærsfeldt og Kim Astrup og Anders Skaarup.

programme.title: Berlin, I Love You / Berlin, I Love You
programme.desc: The story returns again after separate love stories in Paris, then New York, then Rio de Janeiro. programme.title: Juliet, Naked / Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: The film tells the story of Duncan's long-suffering lover, Annie, and her long-suffering romance with singer-songwriter Tucker Crowe, a relationship that becomes the subject of Duncan's musical obsession. / يروي الفيلم قصة آني حبيبة دنكان التي عانت طويلًا، وعلاقتها الرومانسية التي دامت طويلًا وخفتت مع المغني ومؤلف اﻷغاني تاكر كرو، وهى العلاقة التي تصير موضوع الهوس الموسيقي لدى دنكان.

programme.title: The Wedding Planner / The Wedding Planner
programme.desc: Mary Fiore is a wedding planner. She knows exactly what to do and say to make any wedding a wonderful event. But when Mary falls in love with the handsome doctor, her busy life is turned upside down when she discovers he is the groom at the biggest wedding of her career as a wedding planner. / تعمل ماري فيوري مخططة لحفلات الزفاف. تعرف بالضبط ماذا تفعل وتقول لجعل أي زفاف حدثًا رائعًا. لكن عندما تقع ماري بحب الطبيب الوسيم، تنقلب حياتها المشغولة رأسًا على عقب حين تكتشف أنه العريس في أكبر حفل زفاف في مسيرتها كمخططة حفلات زفاف.

programme.title: Basic / Basic
programme.desc: The film's events revolve around former army officer Tom Hardy, whose friend the Colonel turns to him to help him uncover the mystery of how a Special Forces officer killed his colleagues during a secret operation in the jungle. However, Officer Osbourne refuses to share with Tom due to the suspicions surrounding him of accepting bribes from local drug dealers until Tom is able to prove his worth. / تدور أحداث الفيلم حول ضابط الجيش السابق توم هاردي الذي يلجأ له صديقه الكولونيل لمساعدته في كشف غموض قتل أحد ضباط القوات الخاصة لزملائه اثناء عملية سرية بالأدغال إلا أن الضابطة أوسبورن ترفض مشاركة توم لما يحوم حوله من اشتباهات لقبوله رشاوى من تجار المخدرات المحللين إلى أن يتمكن توم من إثبات جدارته.

programme.desc: The film tells the life story of Dick Cheney, the most powerful vice president in history, and how his policies were able to change the world. programme.title: The Other Guys / The Other Guys
programme.desc: The events of the film deal with the story of two detectives in New York City, who, through a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, are able to achieve widespread fame and a good reputation until they become among the most competent in the entire city. However, things do not go exactly as the two policemen were thinking, especially with the entry of (David Ershon) into the picture. / تتناول أحداث الفيلم قصة محققان في مدينة نيويورك، يتمكنان من خلال فرصة لا تتكرر من تحقيق شهرة واسعة، وسمعة جيدة حتى يصيرا من بين اﻷكفأ على مستوى المدينة بأسرها، ولكن مع ذلك لا تسير اﻷمور بالضبط كما كان يفكر فيها الشرطيان، خاصة مع دخول (دافيد إرشون) في الصورة.

programme.desc: The film's events revolve around police officers and their confrontation with drug smuggling operations. programme.title: Keanu / Keanu
programme.desc: The film's events revolve around Reel losing his pet, Keanu, from home. programme.title: The Loud House / The Loud House
programme.desc: Inside the Loud family home, the house is full of noise and madness all the time, especially with the presence of 11 children in the house: 10 girls and only one boy named (Lincoln), and this terrible disparity generates all the time many comedic situations inside and outside the house. / داخل منزل عائلة (لاود)، يموج المنزل طوال الوقت بالصخب والجنون، خاصة مع وجود 11 طفلًا في المنزل: 10 فتيات وصبي واحد فقط يدعى (لنكولن)، وهذا التفاوت الرهيب يُولد طوال الوقت الكثير من المواقف الكوميدية داخل المنزل وخارجه.

programme.title: Inheritance Part 3 / الميراث ج3
programme.desc: Overnight, the conditions in this part change. With Haifa’s reappearance, Youssef decides to reconcile his calculations, marry her, and forgive her, while fire breaks out between Dima and Majed and they divorce, and Sahar decides to take revenge on everyone who caused her son’s death. / ما بين ليلة وضحاها تتبدل الأحوال في هذ الجزء، فمع عودة هيفاء للظهور مرة أخرى يقرر يوسف إعادة حساباته والزواج منها ومسامحتها، في حين تشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد ويقع الطلاق بينهما، وتقرر سحر الانتقام من كل من تسبب في وفاة ابنها.

programme.title: Miss Farah Part 5 / الآنسة فرح ج5
programme.desc: The events of the fifth part revolve around Farah preparing to marry Shadi, but soon she faces a series of surprises that force her to adapt to her new reality, and events continue. / تدور أحداث الجزء الخامس حول استعداد (فرح) للزواج من (شادي)، ولكن سرعان ما تواجه سلسلة من المفاجآت تجبرها على التأقلم مع واقعها الجديد وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Except me, part 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. programme.title: أمير البحار / أمير البحار
programme.desc: نور الدين البحر(لطفى لبيب)رجل أعمال متيسر يمتلك يختا إسمه أمير البحار، يعهد برعايته للبحرى رفاعى (حسن عبدالفتاح)، ولديه ٤ بنات هن فيحاء(نورا السباعى) ولمياء ( أمينه ) وجيداء (كريمه عبدالله) وشيماء (شهيره سعد)، وإبن وحيد هو أمير (محمد الهنيدى) الذى تمتع بتدليل خاص من أمه (هناء الشوربجى)، فشب لايتحمل أى مسئولية، حتى أمضى ١٢ عاما فى الأكاديمية البحرية، ولم يتخرج بعد، حتى اصبح زملاء دفعته، رؤساءه الآن، ويرأس الأكاديمية جارهم منصور الهلباوى (غسان مطر)، والذى كان أمير يحب إبنته سلوى (شيرى عادل) التى تربى معها منذ الصغر، وكانت امها دريه (مها ابو عوف) تشجعه على ذلك مع تدليله، بينما كانت سلوى تشعر أن أمير مثل أخيها، وتتذكر أنهما كانا يستحميان وهم صغار فى نفس البانيو، وقد كانت سلوى تحب الشعر، وتميل لأى شاب شاعر، وتشجعه على التقدم لخطبتها، غير أن أمير كان يستعين بالبلطجى ممس (محمد محمود)، فى خطف الخطيب وتهديده حتى لايتقدم لخطبتها، حتى بلغ عدد الخطاب ٩، كان آخرهم الشاعر مؤنس توحيد (حسام داغر)، الذى خطفه وأمه (مريم سعيد صالح)، وتوعده بالقتل لو رآه فى شوارع الاسكندرية. وبالاكاديميه كان أمير دائما مخالفا للتعليمات، مصطحبا معه أصدقاءه طارق (طارق الابيارى) وشريف (شريف صبحى)، وكانوا دائما معرضين لطوابير الذنب، التى يقودها زميله القديم نزار مرسى الشافعى (ياسر جلال)، الذى كان انتهازيا ويمارس حقده على أمير، ويبتزه مدعيا انه يساعده على التقرب من سلوى، بينما كان نزار يسعى لخطفها منه، لأنها إبنة رئيس الأكاديمية، وعندما يأس نور الدين من تخرج إبنه وتحمله مسئولية يخت أمير البحار، عرض اليخت للبيع على السيد سليم بيه (صبرى عبد المنعم)، وعانت اخوات أمير من العنوسة، وتسابقن للفوز بنزار عندما زار أمير بالمنزل، غير ان امير اخبرهن كذبا أن نزار خاطب، وتقدم حجازى (محمد فاروق) الذى يستورد البمب ويبيع الكنافة فى رمضان، لخطبة شيماء، ولكن امها علقت طلبه حتى يوافق أمير، الذى لم يجد غضاضة فى حجازى، الذى يسعى لأن يكون رجلا فى بيته، وإتفق أمير مع نزار أن يتقابل مع سلوى، ويخبرها بمزاياه حتى توافق عليه، متحملا كل نفقات تلك المقابلات، ولكن نزار إستغل الموقف وأفهم سلوى انه شاعر، وبثها حبه، وأخبرها ان أمير له صديقة تدعى سوزى (مريم نور) بينما كانت سوزى صديقة نزار. قرر الهلباوى التخلص من أمير فإعتمد نجاحه وتخرجه، مع عدم مسئولية الأكاديمية عن أى مركب يكون أمير قبطانها، وفى حفل عيد ميلاد سلوى، أعلن الهلباوى خطبتها على القبطان نزار، مما احبط أمير وأصابه بصدمة ولكى ينسى شرب بيرل بدون كحول ليسكر وينسى، وقرر إقامة حفل تأبين لحبه باليخت أمير البحار، حضره أصدقاءه طارق وشريف، وأمه وأخواته البنات وحجازي خطيب شيماء، ودعا له ضحيته مؤنس الشاعر، ولكن سوزى اتصلت بسلوى وأخبرتها بحقيقة نزار، فإتصلت بأمير تستنجد به، فأمرها بترك المنزل، واللحاق به على اليخت، وأمر رفاعى بالخروج لعرض البحر بأقصى سرعة، ولم يتوقف أمير باليخت حتى نفذ البنزين، وحاول ان يشغل جهاز الاستغاثة الذى يعمل بالزيت، فإكتشف ان امه استخدمت الزيت فى قلى البطاطس، واسقط فى يد الجميع بعد ان نفذ الماء، ثم وجدوا غريقًا بالبحر متعلقا فى عوامة، وعندما أخرجوه إكتشفوا انه البلطجى ممس، الذى حاول البحث عن فرصة أفضل، فإستقل مركبا فى هجرة غير شرعية، فلما غرق المركب، تعلق بالعوامة، فلما انقذوا، لامهم على ذلك لأنه كان يتمنى الموت، وإنضم للجميع ليكتشف انه لم ينقذ بعد، ولكن اليخت تعرض لمجموعة من القراصنة، بقيادة الريس حزنان (ضياء الميرغنى) استولت على المركب، وقيدوا من فيه، واستولوا على ملابسهم، وطلبوا نصف مليون جنيه عن كل رأس، ولم يستسلم نزار واستقل زورقا للبحث عن سلوى، حتى عثر على اليخت، وإنضم للمختطفين، وقاربت المحنة بين فيحاء ورفاعى، وبين لمياء ومؤنس، وبين جيداء ونزار، الذى عاد لرشده اخيراً، وقرر التوبة والتكفير عن أفعاله السابقة، واراد حزنان قتل أحد الرهائن حتى تأتى الفدية، وتمسك الجميع بالحياة، حتى تقدم أمير مضحيا بنفسه، وتم إلقاءه فى الماء، فى نفس اللحظة التى جاءت فيها أموال الفدية، فألقى نزار بنفسه فى الماء وأنقذ أمير، واستطاع أمير إستغلال طريقة توزيع الفدية على القراصنة، وأوقع بين حزنان وبين رجاله، بينما تمكن نزار وباقى اخوات أمير، من مغافلة القراصنة، والقبض عليهم وتقييدهم، وطلب أمير من ذويهم ٣ آلاف دولار عن كل رأس. وفى حفل كبير تزوج أمير وإخواته البنات. programme.title: سرايا عابدين ج1 / سرايا عابدين ج1

programme.title: زهايمر / زهايمر
programme.desc: محمود شعيب(عادل إمام)رجل ثرى نام يوم الأحد ليستيقظ بالصباح ويكتشف انه الخميس، وأن هناك مجموعة من الأفراد فى المنزل لايعرفهم وهم الممرضة منى (نيللى كريم) والخادمة إجلال (إيمان السيد) والجناينى عيد (محمدالصاوى) وإدعوا انهم فى خدمته منذ سنتين وإنه مصاب بالألزهايمر، واتصلت به تليفونيا سوسو وتوتو وميمى ليخبرنه انه كان بأحضانهن ايام الاثنين والثلاثاء والاربعاء، ولأنه لايتذكر أى شيئ، فقد استدعى خادمه حامد (ضياء الميرغنى) الذى يعمل فى خدمته وحده منذ سنوات، والذى أكد له كل المعلومات السابقة وأنه مصاب بداء النسيان، حتى ماسح الأحذية فرحات (مصطفى يوسف) حدثه عن حذاءه الأبيض، وهو الذى لم يرتدى فى حياته حذاء ابيض، غير انه اكتشف وجوده تحت السرير، وحتى يتأكد محمود من حقيقة مرضه، حاول الخروج من المنزل لمقابلة أصدقاءه، ولكنه اكتشف وجود البودى جارد ياسر (خالد عبد العزيز) يمنعه من الخروج بأمر الطبيب، فإضطر لإستدعاء أبناءه الذين طردهم من المنزل منذ ٦ شهور بسبب سوء تصرفاتهم المالية، وهم الابن الأكبر سامح (فتحى عبد الوهاب) والابن الثانى كريم (احمد رزق) وزوجته نجلاء (رانيا يوسف) المهيمنة على تصرفاته، وابنتهم الصغيرة ملك (فريده الحارونى)، جاءوا جميعا ومعهم الطبيب المعالج شاكر (هناء عبد الفتاح) الذى لا يتذكره بالمرة، وأكدوا جميعا له أنه مصاب بمرض الألزهايمر، وانه يجب ان يلزم الفراش لمدة أسبوعين، مع تناول الأدوية، لكن محمود تحايل على الجميع وخرج من المنزل وقابل صديقه رجل الاعمال شافعى (احمد راتب) الذى أكد له إصابته بالمرض منذ سنتين، وأثناء عودته عرج على محاميه القديم عمر كمال(سعيدصالح) وعلم انه مستقر بدار للمسنين، حيث زاره ليكتشف انه مصاب بداء الألزهايمر وانه يتبول لاإراديا، وقد تنكر له ابناءه ولم يزوروه فى مرضه، وخرج محمود من الدار منهارا، يشعر ان ذلك هو مصيره الحتمي، وعاد لفيللته وعاود تناول الدواء فى يأس بالغ، حتى ساءت حالته وفقد رغبته فى الحياة، ولكن استدعاء السباك (يوسف عيد) لإصلاح الحنفية المكسورة، كان نجدة له من السماء، إذ أخبره انه جاء مرارا لإصلاح الحنفية ولم يرى غير حامد، مما جعله يضغط على منى الممرضة، لتبوح له بالحقيقة، فقد استأجرهم ابناءه سامح وكريم لإيهامه بالمرض واشترك معهم صديقه شافعى والدكتور شاكر وماسح الاحذية، وان حامد يضع له دواء فى المشروبات ليجعله مشتت الفكر، وأنهم اعطوه منوما شديدا يوم الأحد ليستيقظ فى الخميس وهى افكار أمدهم بها المحامى (لطفى لبيب)، كل ذلك لأنهم قد رفعوا عليه قضية حجر، ستنظر بعد أسبوعين، والسبب انهم حصلوا بالاشتراك مع شافعى، على قرض كبير من البنك، وخسروه فى البورصة، وأنهم جميعا معرضون للسجن، وإتفق محمود مع د.شاكر ومنى وباقى الخدم على خطة لمجابهة أبناءه، بأن غاب عن الفيللا لمدة أسبوعين، ثم عاد بعد تشاجره مع رجل بالطريق ليذهب لقسم البوليس ويثبت بتصرفاته انه مصاب بالمرض، وسحب كل أرصدته من البنوك، وضرب عقود بيع لكل ممتلكاته، وضرب عقدين عرفيين بالزواج من منى وإجلال، وأمام القاضى (ياسر على ماهر) أثبت إصابته بالمرض، ليتم الحجر عليه، ولم يجد أبناءه الأموال التى سحبها من البنك أو التى باع بها أملاكه، ولجأوا للإقامة بالفيللا للبحث عن الأموال، وتولى محمود إعادة تربية أبناءه من جديد، بعد ان أحال حياتهم الى جحيم ومعهم نجلاء زوجة كريم، واكتشفوا زواجه العرفى من منى وإجلال، وإضطرت نجلاء لبيع مصاغها ليحصلوا على عقود الزواج العرفى من منى وإجلال، ثم اكتشفوا سفر والدهم الى بيروت لدى صديقه القديم عدنان (رفيق على احمد) وسافروا وراءه، ليكتشفوا انه سلم كل امواله لعدنان مقابل صفقة هيروين، وطلب منهم بيعها فى مصر لتسديد القرض، وجعلهم طمعهم للترحيب بالفكرة، غير انهم ضبطوا بالمطار وتم إيداعهم السجن حتى يأتى تقرير المعمل الجنائى، الذى قرر ان البودرة عباره عن دقيق قمح، وافرج عنهم بعد نشفان دمهم، وأبلغهم والدهم انه سدد عنهم القرض، بعد ان لقنهم درسا قاسيا، وأمدهم ببعض المال وطلب منهم حسن التصرف، كما طلب منهم ان تقيم حفيدته ملك معه ليحسن تربيتها.
